_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We operate, franchise, or license 4,175 properties worldwide, with 714,765 rooms as of year-end 2014'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties for customers'; 'Economic uncertainty could continue to impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business'; and 'Our 2014 results reflected a favorable economic climate and demand for our brands in many markets around the world, reflecting generally low supply growth in the U.S. and Europe, improved pricing in most North American markets, and a year-over-year increase in the number of properties in our system' (its own FY2014 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We operate, franchise, or license 4,175 properties worldwide, with 714,765 rooms as of year-end 2014'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties for customers'; 'Economic uncertainty could continue to impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business'; and 'Our 2014 results reflected a favorable economic climate and demand for our brands in many markets around the world, reflecting generally low supply growth in the U.S. and Europe, improved pricing in most North American markets, and a year-over-year increase in the number of properties in our system' (its own FY2014 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.86x; +28% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.23; conservative 2yr +19%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -37.6%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.3%/yr (Q4 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.3%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2015-11-06) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.86x (68.7% downside to Bear $24 / +36.9% upside to Bull $105) | Adj composite 2.40 vs market 2.62: gap -0.23 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +29% above the EPP floor $60 (19x FY15E $3.14) | Conservative 2-yr case: +19.4% total (+9.7%/yr) | At 24.4x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $101 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; North American RevPAR +3.6% in Q3 2015, forward fee revenue +6.98-9.3% (Q4 2015 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
